pin.title: Only you
pin.meaning: Your own work and pay on a shared tablet: enter your PIN, even if your badge signed you in. The screen closes after 60 seconds without a touch.
pin.again: It has been a moment: enter your PIN again to go on.

privacy.who: No one else sees it here. It shows you, never anyone else.
privacy.plain: You may see your own records, the work you did and what you were paid for it.

gate.plain: Figures about one person's work need a legal basis on record at the site before anyone sees them, you included.

offline.title: My day needs the network
offline.body: Your own figures are not stored on this tablet, so they cannot show without the network. Your work is still recorded: come back when the network is back.

station.title: This site records stations, not people
station.body: There is no personal list here: scans name the station, not you.

closing.title: Still reading?
closing.body: Your figures leave the screen in a moment, so nobody else sees them.

today.title: Today
today.minutesHint: Your good pieces × the operation's minutes
today.earnedHint: So far: it may still change
today.notLinked: Your floor sign-in is not linked to your employee record yet. Your pieces show; for minutes and pay, ask the office.
today.gateOff: Minutes and pace are off at this site: its legal basis for one person's work figures is not on record.
today.trainee: You are in training today: minutes and pace do not count against you.
today.held_one: {count} scan is held until your clock-in shows it. Nothing is lost.
today.held_other: {count} scans are held until your clock-in shows them. Nothing is lost.

pace.title: Your pace
pace.ON_PACE: On the line's target so far
pace.BEHIND: Under the line's target so far
pace.NO_TARGET: No target to measure against yet
pace.shared_one: {count} report shared with others is left out.
pace.shared_other: {count} reports shared with others are left out.
pace.only: Your pieces against the line's target. Nobody is compared with you.

done.sent: Sent. The team leader or HR answers you here.
done.existing: You already disputed this entry: the open dispute stands.

dispute.question: What is wrong?
dispute.who: The team leader or HR answers. You see the answer here.

none.title: No disputes
none.body: If an entry is wrong, open it in Your records.

statement.title: Your statement
statement.draft: Not approved yet: it may still change.
statement.sent: Sent to the office printer {printer}, in your name.
statement.pdfReady: PIN accepted: press Open as PDF.

none.title: No statement for this month
none.body: It is made when the period is run.
none.noPay: This month has no piece pay.

held.draft: Only an approved statement can leave the screen.
held.noPrinter: The tablet does not know which printer is the office one: ask the office to print it.
held.months: A statement goes back a year here: older ones are at the office.

row.undone: This entry was undone: nothing to dispute.
row.running: This block is still running: dispute it when it ends.

refusal.other: This was refused. Ask your team leader.

NOT_APPROVED.message: This statement is not approved yet.
NOT_APPROVED.fix: It can be printed once HR has approved it.

NO_PRINTER.message: The tablet does not know which printer is the office one.
NO_PRINTER.fix: Ask the office to print your statement.

PHONE_ONLY.message: A shared tablet keeps no statement.
PHONE_ONLY.fix: Print it at the office, or open it on your own phone.

DISPUTE_NOT_OPEN.fix: Its answer is in Your disputes.
